product_one_liner.value: Trusaic helps global enterprises analyze and remediate pay inequities, make compensation decisions, and manage pay-transparency reporting.

pricing_page.notes: Its official ADP Marketplace listing has an Editions & Pricing page for ACA Complete; viewing the price requires login.

founded_year.notes: Trusaic dates its foundation to 2014; the Trusaic rebranding occurred in 2019.

eng_blog.notes: The blog primarily covers pay equity, regulation and products; it did not establish two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: No public multi-article documentation site, help center or developer portal was found. An isolated marketplace customer-guide PDF exists.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official board lists only a Sales Development Representative position and no qualifying AI, ML or data-science titles.

model_provider.notes: No underlying AI model or model provider was disclosed in the reviewed AI FAQs, blog, trust/subprocessor or privacy materials.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 certification and GDPR compliance; GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Listed as unfunded, with no funding rounds recorded; the profile was updated on 2026-10-11.

raised_18mo.notes: No outside funding rounds are recorded.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The board's sole SDR listing explicitly states that it is currently not accepting applications.

launched_6mo.notes: On 2026-05-20, Trusaic introduced an enhanced EU Pay Transparency Directive monitor with interactive mapping and country-specific implementation tracking.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Lynn Kaiser's profile gives a November 2025 start without an exact day, so her appointment could not be placed reliably relative to the 2025-11-09 cutoff.

crm_stack_signal.notes: HubSpot-hosted demo scheduling is visible; this indicates a sales workflow, not confirmation of its entire internal CRM stack.
